problem: Which of the following expressions gives all of the zeros of the function $f(x)=\operatorname{tan}⁡(\frac{x}{4}-\frac{\pi }{3})?$ Assume that $n$ is an integer.

feedback.problem: Which of the following expressions gives all of the zeros of the function $f(x)=-4\operatorname{cot}⁡(4x)?$ Assume that $n$ is an integer.
feedback.worked_solution:
The zeros of $y=\operatorname{cot}⁡x$ are given by 

$$
x=\frac{\pi }{2}+n\pi ,
$$

where $n$ is an integer.

To find the zeros of $f(x)=-4\operatorname{cot}⁡(4x),$ we replace the $x$ on the left-hand side of the above with $(4x).$ This gives

$$
4x=\frac{\pi }{2}+n\pi .
$$

Solving for $x,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}4x & =\frac{\pi }{2}+n\pi  \\ x & =\frac{\pi }{8}+\frac{n\pi }{4}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we conclude that the zeros are $x=\frac{\pi }{8}+\frac{n\pi }{4},$ where $n$ is an integer.
